svg.aria-label: Who does each step of building a simulator
svg.title: Who does each step of building a simulator
svg.text: Agent or VLM does it itself
Given in advance or by hand
Agentic End-to-End · one Agent does it all
Closed-loop Workflow · roles fixed in advance, problems go back to the responsible step
Open-loop Workflow · roles fixed in advance, run once in order
Model-based (without Agent) · models or optimization produce the result
